bb.title: Bag tier box
bb.sub: The "take more, pay less" box on the bag: Take 2 | Take 3 | Take 4.
bb.note: The tiers and their prices come from your Build-your-own-set rules in Smart Rules. This page only decides whether and how the bag shows them; it never changes a price.
bb.readOnly: You can look at this page; changing it needs permission to change combos.

master.title: Show the "take more, pay less" box on the bag
master.on: On: a computer shows the box beside the suggestions when something in the bag is covered by a running rule.
master.off: Off: the bag shows no tier box. The rules' prices still apply at checkout.

f.to: Shows until (last day, empty = no end)
f.phone: Full box on the phone too
f.phoneHint: The box is made for computers; on a phone the bag shows one short line. Switch this on to try the full box on a phone.

rules.title: Build-your-own-set rules
rules.sub: Each rule's tiers and prices, read only. Switch a rule off to keep its tiers out of the box (the rule itself keeps working). Words: your own text for a tier.
rules.none: No Build-your-own-set rule yet. Make one in Smart Rules; it shows here.
rules.open: Change prices, days and products in Smart Rules

bb.wordsHint: Empty = the shop's own words ("{n} polos"). Up to 60 letters. English is used when Bengali is empty.

pv.title: Preview
pv.sub: The box for "{name}", with today's draft, before you save.
pv.none: Nothing to preview: no rule with a price is switched on here.
pv.head: Buy more, pay less
pv.note: The saving each customer sees is worked out against the price of the item in their own bag.

bb.saved: Saved. The bag shows it now.
bb.unsaved: You have changes that are not saved yet.

err.INVALID_INPUT: Something is not right. Check the days (the last day after the first) and the words.
err.STALE: Someone saved a moment ago. Reload the page.
err.forbidden: You do not have permission to change combos.
